package gateways

import (
	"context"

	models "example.test/gwapp/internal/models/gateways"
	"example.test/gwapp/internal/scope"
)

// Revoke moves a gateway to the revoked state through generated code: authored
// SQL may not write the machine state column.
func Revoke(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	ports RevokePorts,
	in models.GatewayRef,
) (models.GatewayRef, error) {
	return ports.Registry.Revoke(ctx, e, in)
}
